title: Billing agent
description: A support agent refunds a duplicate charge. It calls one tool 3 times with the same arguments, waits 30 seconds for a gateway timeout, and sends its whole conversation again on every call.

input.content:
You are the billing support agent for a medical clinic.
Follow billing policy BP-14. Verify the patient before any account change.
Never reveal full payment details. Refunds above 500 USD need supervisor approval.
Be concise and warm. Today is 2026-11-12.
Hi, this is Hana Lin. I was charged twice for my visit on October 28 — $186 both times. Can you refund the duplicate?

tools.name: lookup_patient
tools.description: Find a patient record by name, date of birth or patient ID. Returns demographics, insurance plan, balance and contact preferences. Use this before any billing action so the right account is changed.

tools.name: get_invoices
tools.description: List invoices for a patient with line items, CPT codes, payer adjustments, payments and status. Results are sorted newest first and include up to 50 invoices.

tools.name: check_refund_policy
tools.description: Ask the policy agent whether a refund is allowed under the clinic's billing policy BP-14, including duplicate charges, insurance timing and approval limits.

tools.name: issue_refund
tools.description: Issue a refund to the original payment method. Amounts above 500 USD need a supervisor approval id. Idempotent per invoice and line item.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email to the patient using an approved template. Templates: refund_issued, refund_denied, need_more_info, payment_plan.

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Create an internal ticket for the billing team with priority, summary and links to the patient and invoices.

tools.name: get_payment_methods
tools.description: List saved payment methods with last four digits, brand and status. Never returns full card numbers.

tools.name: add_note
tools.description: Add a note to the patient's billing record. Notes are visible to staff only.

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.description: Hand the conversation to a human billing specialist with a summary of what was checked and what remains.
